data_fields.name: bleed_chance_per_damage_point
data_fields.donor_constant: rand() % 10 < delta: 1 in 10 per point, always at 10 or more

data_fields.name: bleed_span_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: 120000 (random part of the 1 to 3 minute length)

data_fields.name: pool_start_stages
data_fields.donor_constant: num_frames capped at 2 (new pool on stage 0 or 1)

data_fields.name: pool_neighbour_limit
data_fields.donor_constant: fewer than 2 pools within delta 1 (3x3 area)

data_fields.name: trail_chance_per_step
data_fields.donor_constant: rand() % 6 == 0 (1 in 6 per move, slimes only)

best_idea: Make a bleed a timed client decal that grows one stage per drip, never duplicates on one tile, and stops adding pools when two already sit in the 3x3 area around the victim.
decision_why: Take the one-pool-per-tile stacking rule, the neighbour cap and the timed bleed as a cosmetic client layer; reject any HP effect from bleeding because the donor has none (npctime.cc:530 TODO) and an HP drip would need the server tick.
acceptance: In a duel a fighter hit for normal damage shows a small pool under them at once; every 0.5-1 s the pool grows one stage up to four; no two pools share a tile; a heal, mend or death stops new stages within one tick; a server test asserts the bleed never changes health.
